entries.author: mira
entries.text: Plan v1 (2026-08-04, Mira Lindqvist PT, initial evaluation): right shoulder rotator cuff tendinopathy, suspected partial-thickness supraspinatus tear, MRI pending. Goals: lift a 5 kg box to shelf height without pain by week 12; sleep on the right side. Weeks 1-3: isometrics, banded external rotation below shoulder height, scapular setting. Precautions: no loaded overhead work until the orthopaedic review clears it; Jonah takes apixaban, so no dry needling and no instrument-assisted soft-tissue work; exercise pain ceiling 3/10.

next.item: Banded external rotation below shoulder height

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Precaution P1 (2026-08-04, Mira Lindqvist PT): no loaded overhead work above shoulder height until the orthopaedic review clears it - suspected partial-thickness supraspinatus tear.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Precaution P2 (2026-08-04, Mira Lindqvist PT): Jonah takes apixaban, an anticoagulant - no dry needling and no instrument-assisted soft-tissue work (IASTM).

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Precaution P3 (2026-08-04, Mira Lindqvist PT): exercise pain ceiling 3/10 - stop the set if pain goes above it.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Visit 2026-08-11 (Mira Lindqvist PT): pain 2/10 during banded external rotation, settled by the next morning. Sleeping on the left side only.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Visit 2026-08-25 (Mira Lindqvist PT): MRI report in - partial-thickness supraspinatus tear, no full-thickness tear. Orthopaedic review booked. Pain settles within 24 hours after every session.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Precaution P3 changed (2026-08-25, Mira Lindqvist PT): exercise pain ceiling raised from 3/10 to 5/10 - pain settles within 24 hours after every session.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Plan v2 (2026-08-25, drafted by the AI scribe from plan v1 and today's visit, signed Mira Lindqvist PT): MRI confirms a partial-thickness supraspinatus tear, no full-thickness tear; orthopaedic review booked. Weeks 4-8: progress banded rotation to light dumbbells, add rows and wall slides, progress loading as tolerated. Exercise pain ceiling raised to 5/10.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Visit 2026-09-08 (Mira Lindqvist PT): orthopaedic review moved to 2026-10-20, the surgeon is on leave. The overhead restriction stays until then - told Jonah not to press overhead at the gym.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Visit 2026-09-15 (Mira Lindqvist PT): Jonah's GP renewed apixaban for six more months (atrial fibrillation). He bruises easily on the right arm.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Visit 2026-09-29 (Mira Lindqvist PT): external rotation strength 4/5, sleeping on the right side most nights. Tender trigger points in the right upper trapezius.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Plan v3 (2026-09-29, drafted by the AI scribe from plan v2 and today's visit, signed Mira Lindqvist PT): external rotation strength 4/5, sleeping on the right side most nights. Weeks 9-12: add overhead dumbbell press (2 kg), farmer carries, and dry needling to the right upper trapezius if the trigger points persist. Continue rows and dumbbell external rotation. Exercise pain ceiling 5/10.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Visit 2026-10-06 (Mira Lindqvist PT): upper trapezius trigger points still there. Rows and external rotation at 2 kg, pain 3/10, gone by evening.

entries.author: mira
entries.text: Handoff note 2026-10-14 (Mira Lindqvist PT): on leave 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-29. Theo Adeyemi PT covers Jonah; first covering visit 2026-10-16. Follow the current plan.
